digest.component_or_area: review-bot test harness and lifespan configuration
propositions: Ordinary test entry of the review-bot ASGI lifespan inherited the production 1200-second shutdown drain, causing tests to hang or run long-duration background tasks.
The test harness now binds SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 1.0s as the default baseline via _bound_review_bot_shutdown_drain autouse fixture in conftest.py.
The review-bot lifespan is safe by default in tests: reconcile_loop and background janitor are stubbed automatically without per-test setup.
Tests may opt into the real production reconcile_loop behavior via a marked fixture while retaining the 1.0s drain bound.
Test-local SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS overrides (e.g., 0.1s) take precedence over the suite baseline to enable purpose-specific drain control.
Production DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS remains exactly 1200 and is unmodified by test changes.
